title: Time well spent
body: I did have to silence the sound but the timer works great when I could see the time ticking away.
author: Mamaof#2tamariki

title: Asked me to review the day after I already left one
body: This app asked me to review, then I left one. And it asked me to give a better rating the following day. Which is annoying when it’s at the front of your screen and you have paid money to use the app.
author: joe182739eow7quq

title: Too slow, will drive insane
body: I paid for the $1 trial and was instantly frustrated by the apps incredibly slow interface, made we want to exit I persisted to get to a point where I had no option but to sign up to another trial. What was the point of paying to begin with?? Already cancelled and removed. Avoid!
author: SelkieJay

title: Non existent customer support
body: It’s been almost 3 weeks now and still no answer. Avoid this app at all costs
author: James2848

title: Terrible user experience
body: I’ve purchased the 1 dollar trial yesterday and just after that I was bombarded with adds as I pressed next to try to get to the app download, somehow I turned out compromising with the premium membership. Beyond that the onboarding experience is terrible, you cannot close a silly video and simple explore the app by yourself. The app itself have a terrible user experience. I really don’t know how on earth this could work for people with ADHD. And now I’m just trying to find a way to cancel this subscription with no success.
author: Bola909088
